description: Everything an agent needs to write, build and ship JVM code the way the OCX family does: the java-quality rule (Error Prone and NullAway as the gate of record, with depth on types, errors, concurrency, resources, security, testing, API design, platform and runtime safety), the kotlin-quality rule (detekt and ktlint with the coroutine rules switched on, depth on nullability, coroutines, errors and resources, API and interop), the gradle-build rule (Kotlin DSL, version catalogs, dependency locking and verification, configuration cache, toolchains, plugin development, distribution and publishing) and the maven-build rule (enforcer, dependency management, release, and the Ant legacy file), plus the jvm-release skill that walks a Maven Central release end to end and the jvm-dependency-triage skill that turns a vulnerability report or a conflicting transitive into a decided, verified change.
name: jvm-essentials
summary: The OCX JVM set — Java and Kotlin source standards, the Gradle and Maven build-file rules, and the release and dependency-triage procedures for an SDK that ships to strangers
